content.rationale: S5-bracket fixes the protocol — the op head read before the operation runs and again after, both ids kept, the run itself untouched — S5-lifecycle which invocations feed it, and G-capture that protocol fixed in a term; M-layout places the module flat at src/markers_capture.rs. It crosses M-jj's runner and reads the head through M-jj-oplog, closes the pair through M-markers-append, and names the store and the carried reasons through M-store and M-markers-persist. One transition: read the live op head, run the given operation untouched, read the head again, keep the (pre, post) pair. A failed read aborts before the run, so nothing is bracketed that never opened; the run's own outcome passes through unexamined, so which invocation brackets stays the caller's call and every failure is carried, never rendered.
